source_spans.quote: The permittee conducting surface coal mining and reclamation operations on natural slopes that exceed 20 degrees, or on lesser slopes that require measures to protect the area from disturbance, as determined by the regulatory authority after consideration of soils, climate, the method of operation, geology, and other regional characteristics, shall meet the following performance standards.

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately captures the mandatory lead-in requirement, the regulated actors, the governing conditions (slopes exceeding 20 degrees or lesser slopes identified by the regulatory authority), and the duty to meet performance standards.

source_spans.quote: The standards of this section do not apply where mining is done on a flat or gently rolling terrain with an occasional steep slope through which the mining proceeds and leaves a plain or predominantly flat area; or where the mining is governed by § 716.3.

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately reflects the statutory exceptions and exemptions where the section's performance standards do not apply, correctly linking as an exception to the general requirement.

source_spans.quote: Spoil, waste materials or debris, including that from clearing and grubbing, and abandoned or disabled equipment, shall not be placed or allowed to remain on the downslope.

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim correctly conveys the prohibition on placing or leaving spoil, waste, debris, and disabled equipment on the downslope in covered operations.

source_spans.quote: The highwall shall be completely covered with spoil and the disturbed are a graded to comply with the provisions of § 715.14 of this chapter.

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately reflects the mandatory highwall backfilling and grading obligations under paragraph (b).

source_spans.quote: Land above the highwall shall not be disturbed unless the regulatory authority finds that the disturbance will facilitate compliance with the requirements of this section.

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately represents the prohibition against disturbing land above the highwall.

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim correctly details the specific regulatory finding that serves as an exception to the prohibition on highwall disturbance in C0004.

source_spans.quote: Material in excess of that required to meet the provisions of § 715.14 of this chapter shall be disposed of in accordance with the requirements of § 715.15 of this chapter.

claim_judgments.rationale: The claim faithfully reflects paragraph (c) requiring disposal of excess spoil in accordance with § 715.15.

source_spans.quote: Woody materials may be buried in the backfilled area only when burial does not cause, or add to, instability of the backfill.
